phase: INS-001D River OS Insurance Lead Presentation
objective: Surface insurance-specific acquisition and quote context inside the existing private River OS CRM relationship workspace without replacing the canonical generic CRM relationship model, introducing a second CRM, or adding automated outreach behavior.

architecture.canonicalRelationshipModel: RiverCrmRelationship remains the primary workspace record.
architecture.presentationPattern: Insurance context is an optional read-model attached to a canonical relationship only when a persisted insurance lead profile exists.
architecture.readOnlyScope: INS-001D adds presentation and read composition only. It does not create public intake, quote-status editing, consent editing, messaging, dialing, calendar actions, carrier actions, or AMS behavior.
architecture.genericCompatibility: Non-insurance relationships render exactly through the existing generic CRM presentation path and are not required to possess insurance records.
architecture.dataSource: Use the existing River CRM 0001/0002 tables and canonical INS-001A/INS-001B constructors/repositories. No new D1 schema is required.
architecture.failureIsolation: Failure to load optional insurance enrichment must not fabricate insurance data. Database read failure must remain distinguishable from a legitimate non-insurance relationship.

presentationReadModel.name: InsuranceLeadPresentation
rules: The read model never duplicates displayName, email, phone, kind, stage, owner, follow-up, or appointment fields because those remain canonical RiverCrmRelationship fields.
Missing optional acquisition attribution is represented as absent context rather than an error.
Consent presentation preserves channel and status semantics from canonical consent records.
doNotContact is true when any current returned consent record has doNotContact true.
Recent event presentation uses canonical relationship events and does not invent derived lifecycle events.
Recent events are capped for workspace presentation rather than rendering unbounded history.
The UI may format labels for readability but must not mutate canonical values.

d1ReadProjection.input: readonly canonical relationship IDs already loaded by the CRM workspace
rules: Read only from river_crm_insurance_lead_profiles, river_crm_acquisition_attribution, river_crm_contact_consents, and river_crm_relationship_events.
Only return presentations for relationship IDs that actually have an insurance lead profile.
Do not create a second relationship identity.
Do not write, upsert, append, update, or delete any data.
Do not require insurance data for non-insurance CRM relationships.
Use bounded queries and avoid one complete four-query enrichment sequence per relationship.
Preserve canonical validation when mapping persisted insurance, acquisition, consent, and event values.
Recent events should be bounded to the newest five events per insurance relationship for workspace rendering.
The CRM page continues to load canonical relationships through createD1RiverCrmPersistence(database).list().
When RIVER_CRM_DB is readable, the page separately loads optional insurance presentations for the canonical relationship IDs.
The relationship list receives insurance presentation context as an additional optional prop.
Generic relationship summary and edit controls remain intact.
Insurance presentation appears only on records with matching insurance context.
Insurance context is visually subordinate to the canonical relationship heading and generic CRM controls.
No automatic message, email, SMS, phone call, callback, calendar action, or carrier action is triggered by rendering the workspace.

insuranceCard.heading: Insurance
consentPresentation: Show each available channel: phone, sms, email.
Show canonical consent status: granted, denied, revoked, or unknown.
Clearly surface do-not-contact suppression when present.
Do not convert missing consent records into granted consent.
eventPresentation: Show up to five recent events.
Do not expose raw metadata JSON blobs by default.
insuranceCard.emptyOptionalFields: Omit or display a neutral dash; never fabricate values.

rules: Metrics derive only from loaded insurance presentations.
Existing generic CRM summary remains canonical and must not be replaced.
Insurance metrics are additive operational context, not a separate dashboard or CRM.

tests: Build an insurance presentation from canonical profile, acquisition, consent, and event records.
Preserve canonical relationship ID.
Do not duplicate generic relationship contact or pipeline fields in the presentation model.
Represent missing acquisition attribution without inventing values.
Preserve consent channel/status values.
Surface do-not-contact when any returned consent record is suppressed.
Bound recent event history to five events.
Preserve recent-event ordering.
D1 projection returns only relationships with insurance profiles.
D1 projection accepts multiple relationship IDs without creating a second identity scheme.
D1 projection performs read-only SQL.
D1 projection never inserts, updates, deletes, upserts, or appends.
CRM page continues to use createD1RiverCrmPersistence for canonical relationships.
CRM page uses RIVER_CRM_DB for insurance presentation reads.
CrmRelationshipList accepts optional insurance presentation context.
Non-insurance relationship rendering remains supported.
Insurance records display product interest and quote status.
Insurance records display source/campaign when present.
Insurance records display channel consent state.
Insurance records display recent events.
Workspace does not introduce automated email, SMS, dialer, callback, carrier, or AMS actions.
No Sesh source, persistence, route, or schema changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing River CRM relationship identity and workspace remain canonical.
Insurance context appears only as optional enrichment of canonical relationships.
Source, campaign, product interest, consent state, quote status, and recent events are visible where available.
No sensitive quote-request fields beyond the existing canonical insurance profile are introduced.
No messaging or telephony action is added.
Focused presentation, D1 read projection, component, and route-wiring tests pass.
Repository-wide pre-existing type debt is not broadened by INS-001D.
No production resource or deployment is touched.
Working-tree scope remains limited to the INS-001D specification and planned implementation files.
